description:
The Aviator is Beachman's second-generation electric café racer. Built from the ground up as a vintage-style EV, it rides like the café racer you always wanted and draws the eyes of the crowd everywhere you park it, without needing to spend hours on a garage floor cleaning carburetors and maintaining a vintage bike.

This is the ultimate ride for the person who wants to truly enjoy their daily commute and explore their city on the weekend. Your ride to work becomes the best 30 minutes of your day, a trip to the coffee shop turns into a reason to take the long way home, and you do it all without burning a drop of gasoline.

Aviator 50 - A 50cc equivalent electric moped

Aviator 125 - A 125cc equivalent electric motorcycle

In the United States the Aviator 125 is a motorcycle. It is registered, plated and insured, and it needs a full motorcycle license. Exact requirements vary by state, so be sure to check your local and state laws on mopeds and motorcycles before purchase to understand how to get riding in your hometown.

The Aviator 125 is our most competent ride, modeled after the iconic 125cc bikes of the 1960s and 1970s. Built with a massively expanded battery capacity and larger motor, it can handle brief highway trips and cover longer suburban commutes. For a more affordable option, small town rides, city center commuting, and exploring one's neighborhood in style, see the Aviator 50.

This is a pre-order. The Aviator 125 arrives in 2027, and reserving yours now puts you in the queue to be one of the very first riders. Full specifications are published closer to launch.

The Aviator is customizable, with plenty of options such as tank paint color, seat materials, and striping. Note that images on this product page may feature additional add-ons that do not come on a stock bike.
